hello.speaker: thessaly
hello.text: Oh. People. I had hoped the smoke would keep them away. Thessaly Wren. I am studying the Barrow's wards, from a sensible distance.

choices.text: Come and study them from an unsensible distance.
Those wards are necromantic. Someone is feeding them.

lore.speaker: thessaly
lore.text: The lights are not random. They pulse, like breath. Something down there is being woken slowly, by someone patient.

impressed.speaker: thessaly
impressed.text: Yes! Exactly! Feeding them, a little every night. Finally, someone who reads. I have so many notes to show you.

corrected.speaker: thessaly
corrected.text: Abjuration, originally. Necromancy is what somebody has turned them into. But you are close, which is more than I expected.

choices.text: Then come and see them up close.
I will leave you to it.

join.speaker: thessaly
join.text: You want me to walk into a tomb. With you. ...Yes. Obviously yes. Let me get my book.

camp.speaker: thessaly
camp.text: Back already? I was just getting comfortable.
